name: android
description: Writes and debugs Android app code outside the UI toolkit: ViewModel and UI state, StateFlow collection with repeatOnLifecycle, SavedStateHandle and process death, repository and data-source layering, Hilt wiring, Room entities, DAOs and migrations, DataStore, WorkManager, notifications and targetSdk behavior changes. Use for symptoms such as "A migration from 3 to 4 was required but not found", form input lost after the process is killed, a StateFlow that reloads on every rotation, "cannot be provided without an @Inject constructor", or a request to add a repository, ViewModel, DAO or worker.
